one_liner: A gym membership that keeps debiting after visits stop.
stop_the_service: In the FitLine account, cancel the membership. Decline a pause, a freeze, and a discount.
stop_the_money: PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or BHIM. Autopay or Mandates, then FitLine, then Revoke.
trap: A two-month pause leaves the UPI mandate Active.
if_they_stay_silent: Revoke does not need the gym to reply. Keep a screenshot of Revoked. If a debit still posts, dispute it with the UTR.

one_liner: Design software. The card is billed whether or not a design is exported.
stop_the_service: Cancel inside the Canva account. An email link often opens a discount, not a cancellation.
stop_the_money: Card app or netbanking, recurring payments, deactivate Canva. If it is missing, ask the issuer to block CANVA.COM PADDLE.NET.
trap: A cheaper plan that keeps the same card on file.
if_they_stay_silent: After 7 days with no confirmation, block the descriptor with the card issuer and keep the cancel date.

one_liner: A fitness app billed by Google Play.
stop_the_service: The switch is not inside the FitApp app.
stop_the_money: Google Play, Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions, FitApp, Cancel.
trap: The in-app cancel opens a survey and leaves the Play subscription on.
if_they_stay_silent: Cancel in the Play Store. A later charge is a Play dispute, then a card dispute.

one_liner: A value-added caller tune. Rs 30 feels small until it is a year.
stop_the_service: Turn the caller tune off in the operator app, or send the operator STOP message shown on this row. The message is a sample.
stop_the_money: The operator removes the pack. There is no separate UPI mandate.
trap: A confirm-by-pressing-1 flow that adds another pack.
if_they_stay_silent: Keep the STOP screenshot and raise it with the operator if the Rs 30 debit continues.

one_liner: Music streaming. A higher price can start inside the same mandate.
stop_the_money: Card app or netbanking, recurring payments, deactivate Spotify. If the foreign descriptor is missing, ask the issuer to block POS 4512 SPOTIFY STOCKHOLM.
trap: Three months at a low price. The card mandate stays live.
if_they_stay_silent: After 7 days, block the descriptor with the issuer. Keep the cancel timestamp.

stop_the_money: Card app, recurring payments, deactivate Google YouTube Premium.
trap: A pause or a free month that leaves the card on file.
if_they_stay_silent: After 7 days, block GOOGLE*YOUTUBEPREM with the issuer.

stop_the_money: Card app, recurring payments, deactivate Netflix.
trap: A downgrade that keeps the card on file.
if_they_stay_silent: After 7 days, block NETFLIX.COM with the issuer.

stop_the_service: Cancel in the Google account under subscriptions.
stop_the_money: Card app, recurring payments, deactivate Google One.
trap: A temporary extra storage offer that keeps the mandate.
if_they_stay_silent: After 7 days, block GOOGLE*ONE with the issuer.

one_liner: One charge a year. Next charge is 15 Aug 2027.
stop_the_money: Card app, recurring payments, deactivate Amazon Prime before 15 Aug 2027.
trap: A reminder that feels like a receipt and does not cancel.
if_they_stay_silent: If the 2027 charge posts after a cancel request, dispute that charge with the cancel date.

one_liner: One charge a year. Next charge is 3 Sep 2027.
stop_the_money: Card app, recurring payments, deactivate JioHotstar before 3 Sep 2027.
trap: A mobile-only plan that still renews the annual charge.
if_they_stay_silent: Dispute a charge that posts after the cancel date.

one_liner: A health policy. Lapsing it is not the same as cancelling an app.
stop_the_service: A separate written request to the insurer. If free-look is still open, the screen says so. This prototype does not give insurance advice.
stop_the_money: Revoke the eNACH at her bank with UMRN HDFC000998877665544.
trap: The insurer says it is stopped while the NACH debit is still scheduled.
if_they_stay_silent: Revoke at the bank with the UMRN, and send the insurer the UMRN and the date.

one_liner: A variable electricity bill. Autopay can stop. The bill cannot.
stop_the_money: Switch off BESCOM autopay in bill pay.
trap: Treating a varying bill as a forgotten subscription.
if_they_stay_silent: Autopay is optional. The amount due is not.

one_liner: Maintenance with uneven dates. It is still a commitment.
stop_the_service: Dues to the apartment association remain.
stop_the_money: Stop the standing transfer only if she has another way to pay the association.
trap: Calling an uneven transfer a one-off.
if_they_stay_silent: Keep the association receipt if a transfer is stopped.

one_liner: A loan repayment. Stopping the debit defaults the loan.
stop_the_service: There is no cancel wizard on this row.
stop_the_money: Do not revoke the ACH. A foreclosure figure is a different product and is not in this prototype.
trap: A cancel button that looks like the gym button.
if_they_stay_silent: Call the lender for a foreclosure figure. Do not stop the mandate from this app.
